title: Classroom Adaptations for Special Populations
description: Historical, legal, and philosophical aspects of special education. Instructional and assessment support for access to general education curriculum. Meets requirements for preliminary multiple, single subject, and education specialist teaching credentials.

title: Selected Topics in Special Education
description: Instructional sequences focusing on a single topic or competency dealing with special education. Topics differ each semester to adjust to current literature in the field, training needs, and resource availability.

title: Special Study
description: Individual study.

title: Typical and Atypical Learning Processes
description: Theory, research, and processes in learning in relation to individuals with disabilities. Foundations of learning, development, and intervention.

title: Field Experiences in General and Special Education
description: Observation and participation in general and special education classrooms and related school activities for students with disabilities.

title: Educational Services for Students with Serious Emotional Disturbance
description: Educational needs and services for students with serious emotional disturbance. Classroom interventions and procedures.

title: Characteristics of Students with Mild/Moderate Disabilities
description: Historical and philosophical perspectives of programs related to students with mild/moderate disabilities. Research on educational programs, curricular approaches, and characteristics.

title: Characteristics of Students with Moderate/Severe Disabilities
description: Historical and philosophical perspectives of programs related to students with moderate/severe disabilities. Research on educational programs, curricular approaches, and characteristics with emphasis on services in context of school reform.

title: Characteristics and Education of Students with Physical, Health, and Sensory Impairments
description: Characteristics, needs, and supports for individuals with physical, health, and sensory impairments in educational, home, and community settings. Implications of health concerns for programming.

title: Special Education in a Pluralistic Society
description: Historical and philosophical perspectives of cultural pluralism in special education and programs related to diverse students with disabilities. Research on curricular approaches and instructional needs. Sociocultural aspects related to disability, race, ethnicity, gender, and language.

title: Young Children with Disabilities and Their Families
description: Characteristics, needs, and educational programs and services for infants, toddlers, and preschoolers with disabilities and their families. Legislative requirements, models of service delivery, recommended practices, and family diversity.

title: Issues in Autism
description: Definition, etiology, assessment, and instructional practices used to address autism. Historical and current issues.

title: Classroom Assessment of Students with Mild/Moderate Disabilities
description: Classroom assessment in general and special education for students with mild/moderate disabilities. Curriculum-based data collection strategies. Influences of cultural and linguistic diversity, and implications for curricular and instructional adaptations.

title: Assessment for Students with Extensive Support Needs
description: Models of assessment emphasizing observation and interviewing, performance-based approaches, transdisciplinary teaming, family-professional collaboration, and adaptations for specific disabilities, cultural, and linguistic diversity for students with extensive support needs. Communicating and using assessment data for individualized program planning.

title: Educational Programs and Services for Young Children with Disabilities
description: Developing, implementing, and evaluating educational programs and services for young children with disabilities. Selecting and adapting curriculum and instructional approaches, collaborating with families from diverse cultural/linguistic backgrounds, and monitoring program effectiveness.

title: Issues in Curriculum and Instruction for Students with Extensive Support Need
description: Practical strategies for working with children and adolescents with extensive support needs in a variety of learning environments. Collaboration with other professionals in the field and involve families as partners in the educational process.

title: Special Education Adaptations of Basic Skills Instruction
description: Language arts and development, mathematics, and reading for students with disabilities. Ability, cultural, and linguistic differences.

title: Advanced Special Education Adaptations
description: Advanced adaptations in curriculum and instruction in content areas, study skills, organizational strategies, and social and transition skills. English-as-a-second language approaches for students with disabilities. Research and practices related to linguistic, cultural, and ability differences.

title: Behavioral Strategies and Supports for Students with Disabilities
description: Positive behavioral supports for students with disabilities in general and special education settings. Current theories and programs in functional assessment and behavioral change. Applications in educational and community environments with diverse students.

title: Facilitating Transition Across Environments in Special Education
description: School to adult life transitions for individuals with disabilities. Whole student approaches to include community experiences, employment preferences, friends and extended family, home and school life, and postsecondary goals.

title: Applications of Technology for Individuals with Disabilities
description: Educational applications of current technologies for learners with disabilities. Selection, modification, and classroom use of technologies to improve or bypass physical, sensory, communicative, learning, and social limitations.

title: Collaboration, Legislation, and Educational Planning in Special Education
description: Collaboration, legislation, and individualized special education program planning skills for working with community resources, parents, and school personnel. Goals, interpersonal processes, legal and ethical issues, listening and questioning techniques, objectives, outcomes, and team functions focused on developing and implementing an individualized education plan.

title: Selected Topics in Special Education
description: Specialized study of selected topics in special education. May be offered as either a workshop or lecture/discussion.

title: Advanced Behavioral and Health Supports
description: Advanced approaches to dealing with behavioral crises and health issues in classroom, to include working with mental health specialists and school nurses.

title: Special Topics in Special Education: Consultant Skills/Multidisciplinary Teams
description: Instructional sequences (mini-courses) focusing on a single topic or competency dealing with special education. Topics differ each semester to adjust to current literature in the field, training needs, and resource availability.

title: Legislation, Leadership, and Management
description: Design and implementation of individualized learning plans for professional development activities. Leadership approaches for managing school-related services within a multidisciplinary context.

title: Advanced Instruction, Collaboration, and Consultation in Special Education
description: Advanced instruction, collaboration, consultation skills, and strategies for working with students, teachers, paraprofessionals, school personnel, other service providers, parents, and representatives from the community.

title: Leadership, Supervision, and Management
description: Leadership through a behavioral lens. Data-informed decision-making, organization behavior management, and performance feedback.

title: Advanced Applied Behavior Analysis
description: Ethical application of research-based strategies based on behavior analysis. Emphasis on arranging learning opportunities to increase student skills and data collection.

title: Advanced Studies in Special Education: Mild/Moderate Support Needs
description: Educational legislation, theories, philosophies, research findings, issues and trends in area of exceptionality. Application of research to solution of educational problems.

title: Advanced Studies in Special Education: Autism, Early Childhood Special Education, and Extensive Support Needs
description: Educational legislation, theories, philosophies, research findings, issues and trends in the area of exceptionality. Application of research to solution of educational problems.

title: Single Case Research Design
description: Single-case research designs focused on interventions with individuals with disabilities.

title: Advanced Topics in Special Education
description: Intensive study in specific areas of special education.

title: Directed Internship: Special Education
description: Application to be made during previous semester. Extensive daily participation or teaching in public schools and preparation for teaching of exceptional individuals.

title: Directed Internship: Applied Behavior Analysis
description: Integration and application of behavior analysis principles. Participation and coaching in selected programs for students with disabilities.

title: Special Study
description: May involve fieldwork.

title: Practicum: Students with Disabilities in General and Special Education: Mild/Moderate Disabilities
description: Participation in general and special education programs for students with disabilities; supervised by a special educator. Integration and application of skills and knowledge gained in credential coursework.
notes: May be taken only once for credit.

title: Professional Seminar in Special Education
description: Discussion and application of student teaching experience and support for special education teacher candidates to submit the Education Specialist California Teacher Performance Assessment (EdSp CalTPA).

title: Advanced Practicum in Special Education: Mild/Moderate Disabilities
description: Culminating practicum for Education Specialist Credential. Participation supervised by a special educator.

title: Advanced Practicum in Special Education: Extensive Support Needs
description: Culminating practicum for Education Specialist Credential. Participation supervised by a special educator.

title: Advanced Practicum in Special Education: Early Childhood Special Education
description: Culminating practicum for Education Specialist Credential. Participation supervised by a special educator.
